reviews.comment: She truly cares about her students and their success in her class. Half your grade consists of a semester long group project that included making weekly instagram posts and writing a 5 page final essay. There were also two exams that were manageable if you studied at least a few days in advance. Highly recommend buying the text book and using it.
She was one of the best professors I've ever had at TAMU. She is so kind and nice! Definitely recommend!
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Group projects

reviews.comment: easy class but I could not understand a WORD the prof was saying. Wears a mask and talks so quietly. Reads directly off the slides. This class was an elective and I regret taking it so much. Makes you write a 5 page paper with 11 people... literally impossible to get that many people to work together. DO NOT TAKE THIS. THERE ARE EASIER OPTIONS.

She made every assignment clear. She would review every assignment with us during the class, which was really helpful. Also, she was supperrrrrr kind and supoortive! The textbook is boring but her lecture is engaging! Would take her class in the future.
Prof. Zou really cares about her students!!! She responded to my multiple emails with patience!! She always offered me the most needed help and support. Strongly recommend this course!!!

reviews.comment: She is super nice because she really cares about her students. The class is well-organized. I'd love to take her class in the future!

Super easy class to take. She does take attendance so you have to go to class but other than that, this class is a breeze. Her lectures are boring. Just copy the PowerPoints she puts up in class which are also on Canvas and you will get an A on the tests. The tests are online. You really don't need the textbook, I haven't touched it all semester.

Zou was the best. She always answered her emails pretty quickly, even though she didn't have office hours since it was a summer asynchronous class. She always gave great feedback on your speeches and is not as tough of a grader as you might think. I wish I could have seen her give lectures since she was really nice and helpful in her emails.
